answer: Here is one mechanism that works: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because kernel only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, dune is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any hollow approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
